description: Returns the full detail of one publicly visible stay: unit type, bed configuration, fixed check-in and check-out dates, itemized pricing in USD, standard cancellation terms, the optional VakayFlex cancellation upgrade with its fee and guaranteed refund, notices such as a parking charge or renovation work, unit amenities such as kitchen equipment, unit policies, resort amenities and the vakaymood.com URL where it is booked. A stay that is no longer publicly visible is reported as not found.
